pages.title: Circuit Board
pages.text: The TFMG board, the brain that steers. The core needs two.

pages.title: The chain
pages.text: $(li)Refine crude oil into plastic$(li)Plastic Sheets and green dye make an Empty Board$(li)Deploy a gold plate on it$(li)Etch it with Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Vat

$(li)Finish with sequenced assembly: Capacitors, Resistors and a Transistor$(br2)Each step is in JEI. It needs a working refinery and a chemical plant, so build these before you plan a trip. See $(l:industry/tfmg_oil)Oil$(/l).
